display_long_description:
🥊 Boxing Academy VR

Master Real Boxing Skills. Train. Fight. Win.

Boxing Academy VR is more than a game—it’s an immersive boxing training experience built entirely for controller-free 🖐️ hand tracking. Throw real punches with your own hands as you learn authentic boxing techniques and put your skills to the test.

🥊 Learn Like a Boxer

Master essential boxing techniques:
👊 Jab • Cross • Hook • Uppercut
👣 Footwork & stepping
💥 Powerful combos like Jab-Cross and Body Jab-Cross

⏱️ Adjustable slow motion makes it easy to learn proper technique and perfect your timing.

🥊 Practice Your Combos

Smash flying combo fruits 🍎🍉 to improve your speed, accuracy, rhythm, and muscle memory.


🏟️ Step Into the Ring — Now in 3rd-Person View

Face powerful opponents in full boxing matches featuring authentic rounds and rest periods. Use jabs, crosses, hooks, and footwork to control your boxer, outmaneuver your opponent, and fight your way to victory.

The 3rd-person view lets you clearly see your boxer’s stance, movement, defense, and punching techniques. Instead of simply throwing wild punches, you can observe and control proper boxing form, learn realistic combinations, and better understand how a skilled boxer moves.

🎃 Arcade Boxing Practice

Put your boxing skills to the test as crazy wizards and drones 🚁 launch pumpkins 🎃 and watermelons 🍉 at you. Dodge, duck, weave, and unleash powerful punches 💥 to smash flying targets and improve reaction speed and accuracy.
